summary: Mafube Local Municipality is a local municipal area located in the Fezile Dabi District of South Africa's Free State province. The note states that its name is a Sesotho word meaning "dawning of the new day". The note is brief and gives no further details about the municipality.
one_line: Mafube Local Municipality is an administrative area in South Africa's Free State, within the Fezile Dabi District, named from Sesotho.
key_facts: Mafube Local Municipality is an administrative area in the Fezile Dabi District of the Free State in South Africa.
The name Mafube is a Sesotho word.
The name Mafube means "dawning of the new day".
Mafube Local Municipality is located in the Free State province of South Africa.
Mafube Local Municipality belongs to the Fezile Dabi District.
